The practice

Let the image speak.

  1. Set an intention. Bring a question, a feeling, or a situation into focus.
  2. Choose your hand. Select a single card, three cards, or five cards, then draw.
  3. Open Cards in hand. Read the images together. The interpretation is yours.

Your hand stays saved until you select Next reading. Clear hides the displayed single card; Shuffle rearranges the unseen deck. Neither releases your hand.

Reset history in the footer restores the unheld cards. Your current hand stays reserved until Next reading.

Cards appear once per cycle. A new cycle begins after the entire collection has been drawn. Your place is saved in this browser when storage is available.
